warnings.message:
STRESS TEST ACTIVE — Results contain INTENTIONAL errors and rejections!
  → reject_open_order: probability=70%, seed=999
    Scenarios (2): EURGBP_refusals_01, EURGBP_refusals_02

Data origin not producer-stamped for 6/6 file(s) — usable, and NOT comparable
  → a parity measurement reads only data a producer stamped itself
  → docs/architecture/data_provenance.md

2/2 Kraken tick file(s) read predate collector format 1.6.0 — their fills crossed NO spread
  → `bid == ask` in those files: the collector recorded no quote, so a zero spread cost is the DATA saying nothing, not the venue being free
  → fees are unaffected and were charged in full
Multi-currency batch (2 currencies: EUR, USD) — cross-currency aggregation is not performed; each currency group shows P&L in its own currency.
39 warning(s) in 4 scenario log(s) — see scenario logs for details
